category_title: Highly anxious students with ASD characterized by pervasive sensory rituals and wariness
scenario_title: Sensory rituals and wariness during dog introduction
minimal_context: The student and tutor are in the school dinner hall for a 20-minute session with a dog.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to spend the next 20 minutes in the dinner hall with the dog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student walks away, becoming very preoccupied with touching surfaces in the room and following markings on the floor in a repetitive manner.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back over here and look at the dog.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student continues performing mannerisms, showing an over-riding interest in the camera equipment rather than the dog.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to bring the dog closer to you now so you can see him.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (The student shows immediate wariness, watching the dog in order to move away as it gets too close, resulting in an anxious withdrawal.)
